Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on scheduling. Small problem on our side: our EU engineering team just moved clocks for DST on Sunday and a couple of folks in APAC took the invite in their local time (leading to a mismatch). The invite currently shows 10:00 CET for us, but when Tom (CTO) forwarded it internally we saw some team members in Singapore reading it as if it were UTC.

Can we do a quick sanity check before sending the final calendar invite? Our goals:
- Keep the meeting in an EU-friendly afternoon window (CET) so Tom can attend.
- Avoid a slot that is too late for your side (we know Sean is in the US).

Proposed options from our side (all CET):
- Tue Mar 30, 15:00–15:45 CET
- Wed Mar 31, 14:00–14:45 CET

I attached a short agenda and a copy of the original invite for reference. Also flagging that our SRE / infra lead (Tom Muller) will join — he uses healthops.eu email.

Thanks,
Kate Reynolds
Director of Product
Lumen Health
